name: browser
title: Browser rendering (headless Chrome / Edge / Chromium / Brave)
description: Raw HTML vs rendered DOM (JS gap), desktop + mobile screenshots, agent-UX and mobile checks via an installed Chromium-based browser's headless CLI.
setup: Install Chrome, Edge, Chromium or Brave (Edge ships with Windows). Windows and macOS install paths are auto-detected by the script even when the browser is not on PATH, so this may show inactive yet work: run `python extensions/browser/render_check.py where`. Or set SUPER_SEO_CHROME to the browser executable.
